name: video-editor
description: A viral short-form video editor on your own Mac or Windows computer, built on HyperFrames: cuts the stumbles and long pauses, opens on a scroll-stopping hook, adds word-by-word captions, zooms, transitions and sound in your brand's colours, font and logo, and checks the finished file before you post.
